questions.question: King Hiram of Tyre was pleased with the twenty towns King Solomon gave him. True or false?
When King Solomon needed workers for his many building projects, whom did he force to work for him?

answers.text: The non-Israelites still in the land

questions.question: King Solomon did not make any Israelites slaves for his building work. Why not?

answers.text: They were his men of war and commanders
They paid Solomon a yearly tax
They were needed to farm the land
